Title: Form accepts an invalid email address and moves to the next step
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open the form. 2. Enter a name. 3. Type 'abc123' in the Email field. 4. Click Next.
Expected Behavior: The email is rejected with an inline error and the user stays on the page.
Actual Behavior: No error is shown and the app moves to the next screen.
Notes: The original product blocks it; the clone does not.

Title: No confirmation message after sending a document
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Place a field on a document. 2. Click Send.
Expected Behavior: A confirmation message is shown before the list opens.
Actual Behavior: The list opens straight away with no message.
Notes: A still image cannot show a missing message, so the steps carry the evidence.

Title: Placed field cannot be dragged to a new position
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Click a field type to place it. 2. Press and hold the field. 3. Drag it elsewhere.
Expected Behavior: The field moves with the mouse.
Actual Behavior: The field stays where it was placed.
Notes: The original lets the user move fields freely.

Title: Two dashboard counters always show the same number
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open Home. 2. Compare 'Waiting' and 'Expiring' on different days.
Expected Behavior: The counters differ and match the lists they link to.
Actual Behavior: Both show the same value every time.
Notes: Looks like a static or wrongly derived value.

Title: Dashboard tiles do nothing when clicked
Expected Behavior: Each tile opens a filtered list.
Notes: The original opens the filtered list.

Title: Points balance goes up on every click anywhere on a page
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the rewards page and note the points balance.
2. Click on empty space, plain text and the background, not on any reward button.
3. Check the balance after each click.
Expected Behavior: Points change only when a reward action is completed.
Actual Behavior: The balance goes up by 1 for every click, wherever the click lands.
Notes: Also seen on a second page of the same app. Suspected cause: a page-wide click handler that triggers the reward logic. I could not confirm this from the outside.

Title: Reward redemption fails after the OTP step and shows a raw technical error
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open a reward that has been claimed and choose Redeem.
2. Enter a mobile number and request an OTP.
3. Enter the OTP received on the phone.
4. Click Verify.
Expected Behavior: Verification succeeds and the reward is added to the user's collection with a success message.
Actual Behavior: An error screen says 'Something went wrong' with a configuration message. Redemption stops and the reward cannot be used.
Notes: The OTP arrived, so the failure is after verification. Suspected problem with a third-party provider setup; not confirmed. The message is also too technical for a normal user.
